reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is exporting agent sessions, traces, and optional feedback scores to Langfuse for observability and delivery monitoring.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体会话、模型生成、工具调用和可选反馈分数导出到 Langfuse，以支持可观测性与状态查看。
summaries.en: Exports DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, model generations, tool calls, and optional feedback scores to Langfuse for observability and delivery status reporting.

capabilities: Exports agent session telemetry as OpenTelemetry traces to a configured Langfuse OTLP endpoint
Can export feedback scores to a configured Langfuse scores endpoint
Uses configured Langfuse project credentials or authorization headers
Supports configurable sharing of turn inputs, context, working-directory information, tool metadata, and session correlation identifiers
Provides local status reporting for trace and score delivery
